# bioexcel/biobb_flexdyn/concoord_disco

## Summary

Wrapper of the Disco tool from the Concoord package.

Structure generation based on a set of geometric constraints extracted with the Concoord Dist tool.

Nextflow adapter of the [ConcoordDisco](https://biobb-flexdyn.readthedocs.io/en/latest/flexdyn.html#module-flexdyn.concoord_disco) building block of [biobb_flexdyn](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_flexdyn) 5.3.0.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_FLEXDYN_CONCOORD_DISCO } from 'bioexcel/biobb_flexdyn/concoord_disco'

workflow {
    BIOBB_FLEXDYN_CONCOORD_DISCO(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_pdb_path` | yes | pdb | Input structure file in PDB format |
| `input_dat_path` | yes | dat, txt | Input dat with structure interpretation and bond definitions |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_traj_path` | yes | pdb, xtc, gro | Output trajectory file |
| `output_rmsd_path` | yes | dat | Output rmsd file |
| `output_bfactor_path` | yes | pdb | Output B-factor file |
| `versions_biobb_flexdyn` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_flexdyn', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of ConcoordDisco properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_traj_path: 'pdb']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_flexdyn container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_FLEXDYN_CONCOORD_DISCO' {
        ext.properties = [vdw: 1]
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `binary_path` | string | "disco" | Concoord disco binary path to be used. |
| `vdw` | integer | 1 | Select a set of Van der Waals parameters. Values: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6. |
| `concoord_lib_path` | string | null | Path to Concoord library files. If not specified will look for CONCOORDLIB conda environment variable. |
| `num_structs` | integer | 500 | Number of structures to be generated |
| `num_iterations` | integer | 2500 | Maximum number of iterations per structure |
| `chirality_check` | integer | 2 | Chirality check. Values: 0, 1, 2. |
| `bs` | integer | 0 | Number of rounds of triangular bound smoothing (default 0), (if >= 6, tetragonal BS is activated) |
| `nofit` | boolean | false | Do not fit generated structures to reference |
| `seed` | integer | 741265 | Initial random seed |
| `violation` | number | 1.0 | Maximal acceptable sum of violations (nm) |
| `convergence` | integer | 50 | Consider convergence failed after this number of non-productive iterations |
| `trials` | integer | 25 | Maximum number of trials per run |
| `damp` | integer | 1 | Damping factor for distance corrections. Values: 1, 2. |
| `dyn` | integer | 1 | Number of rounds to dynamically set tolerances |
| `bump` | boolean | false | Do extra bump check |
| `pairlist_freq` | integer | 10 | Pairlist update frequency in steps (only valid together with bump) |
| `cutoff` | number | 0.5 | Cut-off radius for pairlist (nm) (only valid together with bump) |
| `ref` | boolean | false | Use input coordinates instead of random starting coordinates |
| `scale` | integer | 1 | Pre-scale coordinates with this factor |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
